title: staleBuild
responsibility: Warns when a dist entry predates files in the checkout source trees; packaged or unreadable source trees produce no warning.

inputs.name: staleBuild.entry
inputs.description: Path to the entry file being checked. Only entries whose immediate parent directory is named `dist` are compared with checkout source trees.

outputs.name: staleBuild
outputs.description: Returns the rebuild warning when `entry` is directly inside a directory named `dist` and an inspected file under the checkout root’s `src` or `crates` tree has a newer modification time. Returns `undefined` for entries outside `dist`, when no newer file is found, or when reading the entry or a source file throws.
examples: Warning: this dist build is older than source; run bun run build:cli before using it.
